nom: La Roche-Posay Lipikar AP+M Triple Repair Body Moisturizing Cream for Dry Skin

avis.texte: I do like this cream for moisturizing, especially my dry skin legs. It is rich, thick and creamy. It does not pump out real well because of how thick it is. When you get low in the bottle you can't really use the pump. But, I like it anyway.
Love this lotion but i hate the bottle and pump. Hate that the pump stops working and there is still 1/2 of the bottle left.

The formula has changed and the new product is trash. It's now called AP+MAX and contains ingredients that cause irritation. I used the product for years with no issues until the ingredients changed. Awful new product.

Love this moisturizer for my skin : I've been having trouble using retinol; dryness, redness, peeling. Now I use this immediately after applying retinol so far no side effects. Keeps my skin moist -Love the glow it gives. Large bottle with pump is so convenient & cost effective

This cream is good, but still not a replacement for my beloved Curel which is becoming hard to find. It has a thick consistency and absorbs well, and it's not stucky or chalky. However, the packaging is STUPID. The dispenser is hard to open and the tube is difficult to squeeze to get the product out. Whoever designed the packaging needs to be fired.

avis.titre: The best body cream I have ever used
avis.texte: I absolutely love this body cream. I am a fan of this brand. I can feel and see the difference in my skin. It doesn't just moisturize. It relieves dry itchy skin and has beneficial ingredients. Highly recommended. Superb.

avis.titre: Just a little sticky, but works very well
avis.texte: It's 2 times better than Aveeno. It sovled my dry skin and it improve my skin texture/appearance. It makes my skin looks better. You would have to deal with a little sticky problem for a few minutes till it dry out.
This hydrates my legs sooo much. I absolutely love it. It's also unscented which is great if you have sensitive skin like me. The big bottle has lasted me a long time.

I followed somebody on TikTok that used to use this lotion and figured what the heck I'm gonna give it a try. I do not buy any other kind of lotion now it's the best one fragrance free fix all those funny dry spots. Perfect lotion for winter dry skin.

LOVE this lotion. I use it on my face with no issues. I feel like it gives my skin the moisture it needs. However, it's thick and once it gets down to a certain level I have to cut the bottle open to get to the rest of the product. I actually transfer it to another container with a lid because there is so much left and I don't want it to dry out. A squeeze tube would be better!!!

avis.titre: you have to cut open the bottle to get the last few ounces
avis.texte: I wish it was double the size and more affordable. However, this lotion truly does not have a fragrance which I love. It's hydrating and not sticky. I've tried so many lotion brands and other lotions from this company and this is my favorite. It has to be the AP+Max Triple Repair Cream. I've tried their other lotion products and this is the best one. The pump and bottle kind of sucks. You have to cut open the bottle if you want to use up the last 1/6 of the lotion. It's very thick and the straw doesn't reach to the bottom. Shea Butter is one of the main ingredients. It was flagged as a potentially comedogenic ingredient in a pore-clogging ingredient checker so just beware. I don't put it on my face for that reason. Other people in my family use it on their face without any problems.

I bought this moisturizer fully trusting its ingredients and hoping it could keep my skin from drying out in the winter. While using it for 60 days, I noticed horrendous skin texture, splotches of red inflammation, and rashes along my jaw and around my nose that would itch to no end. I attributed these to being allergic to something in my environment, but decided to start cutting down my skincare products to isolate a cause. Within 24-48 hours of stopping use of this cream and reverting to my Korean skincare, my skin irritations started to subside. I've currently been off of it for almost a week now and am slowly seeing improvements to my skin, but it'll be a while before I can truly heal the amount of damage this moisturizer did to my face. Please don't blindly trust a well-known brand like I did, I certainly (painfully) learned my lesson.

I've been applying lotions, creams, and body butters straight out of the shower for 25+ years, so I know my moisturizers. This lotion has been in steady rotation for over a year now. Moisturizing is non-negotiable for me, and this long lasting cream provides deep hydration, softens the skin beautifully, and gives a healthy glow. I love that it works well on both body and face. My only issue is the packaging. This is a dense cream, not a thin lotion, and the bottle makes it difficult to dispense once you're about 1/3 of the way through. I end up cutting it open and transferring it to a jar every single time. La Roche-Posay, please consider repackaging this in a jar!
just bought my second bottle. my daughter i use this everyday. it gives my skin a nice shine and great hydration without being sticky.
Love this lotion! It does everything it says it does...but the pump has a hard time dispensing how thick it is. I usually had to remove the pump.
So easy on my sensitive skin!!! A product line I can trust!!! Thank you!!!

avis.titre: Love this brand and their entire product line!!!
avis.texte: Such great products especially for people with skin sensitivity!!!
The reason for 4 stars is there is such a waste due to the thickness of the product. The pump stops working when there is about a 1/4 of product left.
This lotion is the best and has long lasting hydration! Great to apply after showering, absorbs quickly. No greasy feel. My 93 y/o mother loved it and is the only lotion she uses!

avis.titre: This is the best cream for really DRY skin.
avis.texte: This goes on, disappears and my skin is soft, not greasy. I used it after 5 weeks in Florida when my skin was the driest it has ever been. I looked at reviews and chose it. This is the One.
Absolutely great moisturizer for dry,mature skin. No need to purchase expensive face moisturizer. Best used only at night, after retinol treatment!

Began using this after starting tret at the recommendation from my dermatologist and it HELPS SO MUCH! Also helped the eczema on my thumb. I've lost count of how many bottles I've bought. Only complaint is getting the rest out of the bottom is hard
I've been using this lotion for a couple of years. It's now AP+Max and is stinkier than ever!

avis.titre: One lotion for  the whole body.
avis.texte: I love this lotion because you don't need another lotion for your face. You can use it all over. You have to worry about it breaking you out ever. Some lotion I couldn't some parts of my body because it break me out. Now no worries.
This is my go too! My absolute favorite! Super moisturizing. Can't live without it

I like everything about this....except the pump. By the time you get down to the bottom it doesn't "flow" down to where you can get the last of it out. Annoying to spend this kind of money to fight to get the bottom third out.

I had high hopes for this product but it disappointed me! It smells horrible and made my fave itch like crazy! I paired it with the matching face wash and it dried my skin out and this product didnt bring the moisture back at all! I will be sticking to my dove! Will be returning this product asap !
I've always had dry skin of some sort but with being pregnant it was even worse. This has really helped my skin stay moisturized all day.

I buy the pump size of this moisturizer. This product works beautifully, but it does exfoliate. If you haven't manually done so, this product will "peel" away at the layer of moisturizer you just put on. So I recommend at least a good exfoliation weekly, so the moisturizer can do the daily work. This makes your skin so soft. Allows a nice makeup application and to some extent acts as a primer. The bottle itself sucks. Most of the time the pump doesn't work or quits working. The bottle is so large, I just transfer a bit to a smaller container as needed.
My skin is soft and moisturized! This has transformed my skin in such a short time. If you suffer from dry rough skin. Please try this. It has changed my skin.

The lotion itself is fine it's not my favorite thick lotion but it works well enough. Though you have to be careful with how much you use if you don't want to end up greasy. The packaging is also horrific the pump stops working with like 25% left in the bottle and its so hard to get the rest out. It's to thick to pour out after removing the top and the only real way to get it out is to cut into the bottle. It needs to be in a tub or something not a pump bottle. Won't be repurchasing again!

I tried this and cicaplast out for a week and I was so dissapointed. It did nothing. I desperatly needed a new moisterizer and was so excited to try these out because all the tret girls with dry skin loved it but i still woke up every morning with my skin flaking from being so dry. Reminds me of cereva ? and cetaphil

Love what it has done for my skin. Just wish the bottles were a little bigger. Also, its so thick that when it starts getting low you cant pump it any more and it is kind of difficult to get it all out.

I use this stuff morning and night religiously on my body and face, and most days at least a couple times throughout the day. I love it!!!! By far the best moisturizer I have tried. I have extremely dry skin, with psoriatic arthritis and psoriasis and it has helped me so much. My only complaint is that its thick so when you get to the end of the product it's nearly impossible to get it out of the bottle. I wish they made it in a tub and even a larger option.
Really like this stuff, it moisturizes well and does not leave a greasy feeling!
I can confirm this works wonderfully on tha fave and body. Will definitely get the biggest size next

Although the product worked as intended, it smelled horrible. It smelled like vegetable oil and, it lingered. Even after a shower without reapplication, the smell was still there. I didn't notice the smell at first. It took a few days but, once I noticed it, the smell was unbearable. It lingers on your skin and in your clothes. It contains rapeseed oil which explains the smell I suppose. I'll just stick with Cerave. I literally felt like I was walking around smelling like I came out of a fried food place that lacked ventilation. Yes, it was that bad. And it even had a rancid/acrid smell to it. Just yuck. Don't waste your money.
Highly recommended! Good price and it is smooth and feels pleasant on my hand. It prevents and soothes a lot of winter cracking.

avis.titre: I will continue to use this product
avis.texte: Best hand & body cream. I get cracks in my fingers & continual use of this helps to heel.

I have severely dry skin and this helped so much. It especially worked wonders on my hands. It gives a really nice protection without leaving a greasy mess. I had a small one for my purse and gave most of it out while visiting relatives. They all loved it too.
My go to moisturizer, I even put my brother on to it and he's using strong acne prescribed medication. It does the job, it's not too heavy and layers nice under makeup.
I love this lotion my new favorite. Soaks in fast and moisturizing makes skin feel soft and supple. Super glad my reconstruction surgeon suggested this!!!
Product feels good at first, but I've noticed my skin is flaky the next day. I've never experienced that with moisturizers from other brands. I find it okay for body, but will avoid for face.

I have been trying this moisturizer out for this winter and it has been doing me great so far! No strong sent which I love. It also doesn't irritate my psoriasis. Very gentle and good for sensitive skin. It's been helping with my dry patches. I love the price for the amount of product too.

This moisturizer has worked wonders on my dry postpartum skin. Within days, my flakey skin cleared up and my skin looks better than it did in the first place. This moisturizer is thick, however it does sit well under makeup.

As someone who has always had dry skin, this is my favorite face moisturizer, especially in the colder months. It hydrates my face so well. I also work in a hospital and use it in my hands and they have never felt better. It can be greasy, but I dont mind bc im going ti bed after i put it on anyway lol

This has been my go to heavy body cream for the winter months. However, the pump cannot dispense the product as it nears the bottom. I end up removing the pump and turning the bottle over to get the product near the bottom. Very annoying, but necessary if you don't want to waste product.

avis.titre: So good for dry sensitive skin
avis.texte: This is the only dry skin moisturizer thst does it for me. Nice and thick, fragrance free, great for when youre using other exfoliating products
I have tried many lotions in the past with average results, but this lotion is excellent at providing all day hydration. Absolutely love it!

avis.titre: I wake up looking like a dolphin I'm so moisturized
avis.texte: The way ts is getting me through winter rn looking more hydrated than my friend's squishy newborn baby

avis.titre: This is the best I've ever used
avis.texte: I have tried many moisturizers and struggled so bad finding something that was worth buying. Something that actually helped my skin .. THIS is the real deal. I will forever be investing in this brand. After just 1 use I could tell such a huge difference.

I struggle with severe hormonal acne-prone skin. I have to be very careful to find a the delicate balance between exfoliating that dead skin and unclogging my pores while not stripping my skin and making it more inflamed. This moisturizer has been AMAZING. when my skin is extra oily, it works great. When my skin is extra dry, it works great. My barrier has been restored and I'm so happy!

This 100% causes my face to break out, most likely due to the fact thag shea butter is the third ingredient in this. I have cystic acne and do not develop small white heads unless its from a product, and this absolutely causes break outs for me. Next issue Im thinking is caused by the niacinamide. I slather my chest with two different lotions before bed, this being one of them. Last night, i did not mix this lotion with the other. My chest itched this morning, didnt really think anything of it. A few hours later i go to shower, and my chest is red and irritated where i had applied the lotion last night. I dont think this is a bad product if you have the type of skin that can tolerate it. However my acne prone and sensitive skin does not like this at all

I found this advertised for dry skin specifically for the winter weather. My skin has been dry, and it has been painful. It has already made my skin feel moisturized and completely solved the pain it was causing. I highly recommend this moisturizer if your skin dries out during the winter weather.
not heavy whatsoever, love love love, i recommend, my face feels so moisturized after!!!
I cant go a day without using this! Its so moisturizing and comfortable on my skin. I noticed such a postive improvement in how my skin looks once I started using this.

I bought this as with the cold winter weather the eczema on my hands has been flaring up and hurting bad leading my knuckles to crack and bleed. I put this on before going to bed and woke up with magically hydrated hands that were no longer in any pain!!! Ive tried tons of other lotions and creams and nothing has helped the way that this has. So grateful for how much this helped.
This is wonderful for my very dry skin. It is so thick and creamy. It works great for all over body use including the face. I will definitely be buying this again!
I've been searching for a reasonably priced product for dry skin. This is it.
Obsessed with this cream, especially for dry winter skin. No smell, absorbs well. SUPER moisturizing. I use for hands and body. I keep the mini in my purse and the pump at home. I LOVE IT.

I've been using this moisturizer for almost two weeks after seeing so many good reviews. I have oily skin, so I was searching for a lightweight moisturizer suitable for my skin. The description says for dry skin, but my oily skin loves it too. I feel it really soaks into my skin and a little goes a long way. Friendly price for sh a big bottle!
Since I discovered this brand I don't even think about trying others. This is the ultimate moisturizer for your whole body, even your face!
This has to be the best moisturizer . If you know of better let me know
Since beginning tret, this moisturizer prevents all side effects. No redness, purging, mild peeling. Lasts a long time and you get a lot for the price point.

I've been using this lotion on my sensitive skin for about a month now and it's definitely made my skin softer and smoother. I'm also seeing less redness and less irritability. Probably gonna be sticking with this one for a bit < 3
This is the worst lotion I have ever tried. I have sensitive skin and not only is this lotion so thick and greasy it also actually makes my skin more dry?? And gives me literal chemical burns.

I bought this for me and my daughter. My dermatologist recommended for my dark age spots and my daughters eczema. Love how it makes my skin feel so soft. Dont use alot I did the first time and it can make you feel sticky at first once it drys my skin was so soft and lighter.

avis.titre: Product is great, packaging and size could improve
avis.texte: I really like the lotion, its very thick, fragrance free and absorbs quickly for how thick it is. My skin feels moisturized all day. That being said I wish it came in a larger size so I wouldnt have re-buy as often and I also hate the pump. This lotion is way too thick for a pump. About 3/4 way through the bottle the pump stops working and you have to unscrew the cap and shake and scrape the last 1/4 of the lotion out. Please change the package to a jar and make a bigger size.
I have never had a lotion that I loved this much. It moisturizes the skin like nothing else! Worth EVERY penny.

Yalllllll!!! I was a diehard double repair girly until I tried the triple repair moisturizer. I am never going back. Ever since I got this product, it has limited my breakouts and my *veryyy* dry skin soaks every bit of this moisturizer up!!! Would recommend this product to everyone!!!
I love a super thick moisturizer. And i love to put a lot on and let it slowly absorb into my skin. This is my go to and will continue to buy

I can not tell you how great this lotion is. Seriously I have no words except for RUN… GET IT… NOW!! I have been using this lotion daily after showering from my face all the way down to my feet and I have NEVER felt so moisturized. Not only is the moisturizing top notch but it is literally making my lines on my face and my stretch marks on my stomach and inner thighs DISAPPEAR. Seriously this stuff is amazing. It only takes 8 pumps to cover my entire body from top to bottom which makes this so economical. It is very thick so it does take a little time to pump it out but it is worth every second believe me. I wish it was the exact same formula in a tub instead of a pump bottle but I guess we can't have everything. I have recommended this to so many people since I started using it. I am 50 years old and I think it's turning back the hands of time for me. Get it ladies and gentlemen!!

I've been dealing with very dry skin on my face for quite some time. I talked with my dermatologist and she recommended this LaRoche Posay moisturizer. I fell in love with it from the first use. My skin is much more hydrated than before and you can use it as more than just a face moisturizer!
This was recommended by our dermatologist. We use this along with the body wash. Our skin has an amazing softness. We have been using this product for years.

I bought this bc a dermatologist recommended it to use along with tret, which i just began using. So far I've had zero side effects from tret, and I think it's bc I use this. Not greasy, absorbs fast, and not expensive. Will buy again
I love this lotion specially the travel size get to put in my purse on the go ready to use on face or body love it

avis.titre: Hydrates and softens without being greasy
avis.texte: I've been using this lotion for just over a year. I loved it from the start, but now, I'm noticing the changes in my skin over time. It's so much softer! My elbows feel as soft as the rest of my skin, the only time that's happened since infancy! It's a remarkable difference.

My fiancé has been using this as a facial and hand lotion for several years. He consistently has dryness around his nose and mouth. This helps soothe those dry patches and doesn't add extra oiliness or contribute to breakouts in other areas of his face.

avis.titre: Feel the Difference in your Skin
avis.texte: When you put it it on it feels thick. As it sets in you can feel the difference in your skin. You'll feel soft and moisturized. The only thing i would say is if it's hot outside and you have leather seats it will look as if there is an oil left behind. Other than that it does the job.

avis.titre: I had to stop using and throw out
avis.texte: I read the reviews and was really excited about this lotion, but honestly my skin didn't like it at all. When I put it on I'm super greasy and the product doesn't absorb into my skin. I have leather seats in my car and the product gets all over. I was even transferring product on tables at restaurants. Also it smells just like vegetable oil. I was so disturbed how I smelled with this lotion because I felt like an oiled up pig or something about to be deep fried. Do not recommend.
This is my favorite go to daily moisturizer - it instantly moisturizes and plumps my skin for hours. I am a repeat buyer - plus you get a lot of product for your $$
It was dermatologist recommendation to me for my very dry but sensitive skin. It is thick feeling going on but my skin absorbs it quickly. Love it!

Great for literally every where on your body. Thick, rich and incredibly moisturizing without any risk of allergic reaction or acne. I use it for my face and eye cream, makeup remover, body lotion and even chapstick sometimes. I am prone to acne even as an adult and this is just the best. My husband has very sensitive skin and gets eczema often from products and this is his favorite moisturizer as well.

I have been using this for about five years now, and I shared it with my mother and my sister who now also love this product. I mostly use it as a facial cream, but I also use it for my body. I have sensitive skin and my sister has eczema but it works really well for both of us. It is fragrance free and I feel it makes my skin look supple and glowy.

I love this lotion!! It soaks in quickly and does not leave you feeling sticky. My skin stays moisturized longer than with other lotions. My only complaint is the pump does not reach the bottom, so there's about a 1/4th left. You have to cut the bottle.
Totally changed my skin texture. It feels hydrated instead of dry.

I love this lotion. It is very rich & creamy. This is a lotion that requires you to take your time rubbing in. I like using it after a shower before bed. It makes my skin feel so supple and hydrated. It does not irritate my skin or make the KP on my arms and thighs worse. Once it has sunk into your skin it does NOT leave any residue or feel greasy or sticky; like i said you just have to take that extra minute for yourself & massage it into your skin.

I have DRY facial skin and eczema patches on my arms, and use this for both, works wonders! It's a heavy cream, sometimes a little sticky after applying. Hasn't caused any breakouts on my face either, will be repurchasing again and again

This is the best hydrating lotion for dry skin. I'm happy I founds this product. Don't waste money on other ineffective brands. I will buy this again and again. I only wish they would package it in a tub so the product can be easily accessed. The pump and the tube have to literally be cut open to access remaining product.

My dermatologist recommended this brand. I didn't know which moisturizer to choose from however, I'm glad that I went with this one. This keeps my skin well moisturized and I make sure to use it in the morning and evening. It's a must have staple for your skincare routine!

avis.titre: Perfect for sensitive, dry, eczema prone skin
avis.texte: This cream doesn't leave a greasy residue and it's perfect for very sensitive, dry, eczema prone skin. My boyfriend uses it daily after the shower and it has made his facial eczema patches disappear. Will continue to purchase!

The worst moisturizer I've ever used. I have dry skin and love thick body butters, oils, and emollient lotions but this was just disgusting. It feels like it sits on your skin surface l. Even after 24 hours when you wash, it will wash off slimy.

avis.titre: It's so rich & hydrating for body
avis.texte: I wasn't sure about this lotion at first application. Initially it felt sticky/tacky. I then realized I was using too much. First of all, I only use it on the body. My favorite way to apply is 4 pumps to damp skin. The shea butter is deeply nourishing & the ceramides lock in hydration & give the skin a beautiful sheen. As an avid sunless tanner, this body lotion is now a must. I can see a substantial difference in my skin texture after just 5 days. Fyi: It is completely unscented.
This rich nutritious cream has a dewy finish and can be used both on body and face at an excellent price point. Anytime I have irritated skin, this cream comes to the rescue

avis.titre: works well for my dry skin
avis.texte: Started using it a week back and can feel the difference. My face was on the brink of peeling due to some dermabrasion scrub I used and after using La Roche I can see it healing. The white spots have gone and my face feels hydrated for a long time.
Best moisturizer ever! made my super sensitive skin feel like a million bucks!!! loved it and DEFINETLY will be buying again.

avis.titre: Great for psoriasis and cracked hands!
avis.texte: This was recommended by an employee, and it works amazingly! My mom has psoriasis on her hands causing her fingers to crack and hurt. After a few days, her hands are almost completely healed. It is slightly oily, but sometimes that's what you need.
If you use it alone its great, but while I was applying this to a client I realize it started pilling, so definitely do not use it underneath makeup, she said it felt great on her skin
I have extremely dry skin. Most products are water based and my skin just absorbs it, leaving me dry. This lotion keeps my face and skin moisturized.

Be careful! I went to reorder this and noticed that they added mineral oil to the ingredients which is a known carcinogen! This is not listed in the current bottle i have. I loved the moisture this gave me but will not use again with this ingredient.

Holy grail moisturizer! Huge bottle that lasts for ever and i can use it on my body too! I've used it twice a day on my face for the last year and ive loved it. Using it with their thermal spring water makes a huge difference. A little goes a long way. I will never use another moisturizer!
I use this on my skin and face, and I feel so moisturized. As my skin has started aging, I've needed a little more for my skin, and this has been great.
O started using this and it made me so confident in my skin i wanted to go without makeup. I ran out and bought a bigger bottle (diff brand) and my face is so broke out 🥲

avis.titre: I will buy this product every chance I get!
avis.texte: This cream saved my skin. I swear by this I always grab a little one to have just in case. If you buy the little one you can always try to see how great this product is.
